subject: architectural landmark read
catalogue_defect: Several Cloudreach destinations present sparse plain or disconnected structures with weak landmark-specific detail
observed_finding: Galefoot's houses, tents, windows and communal fire give a coherent lived camp. Windscar Beacon reads as an arch with hanging lights and banners but has little landmark-specific mass or surrounding built detail. Sky Shrine approach puts the column group at the far left of an ordinary meadow; its reverse view is entirely covered by a rock surface. Cliffhold approach is dominated by the corner of a house and does not reveal the settlement. These supplied viewpoints leave architectural destination identity uneven.

Height is legible, but exposed edges lack the weathered beds, broken transitions and meter-scale rocky shaping required by the target.
